info.name: gsm-system 2.1 / 2.1 API
info.description:
The /api/v1-only contract. Send manually to execute a request; no additional client enable switches are required. Preset CRUD persists data but never starts a cell. New stores contain editable defaults 0–4. The CRUD fixture uses lab-900 and does not edit/delete defaults. Use only the Read-only folder for read-only inspection; do not Run the whole collection because starts, deletes and SMS submissions have real side effects. HTTP 202 for SMS means submitted, never delivered. Replace placeholders; never commit real hosts, IMSIs, phone numbers or Tokens. network names the container interface (default eth0), not a host NIC.

仅包含 /api/v1，手动点击 Send 即执行，无额外启用开关。新库包含五套预设，CRUD使用独立lab-900且不启动小区。只读检查仅运行查询分组；不要全量运行集合，启动、删除和短信提交会真实执行。所有真实主机与敏感数据留在私有环境中。

Preset and Custom start are separate requests. start_preset_id selects any stored preset; default_preset_id is for read-only queries and preset_id remains the CRUD fixture. All custom fields are variables, including band and short_name. Malformed, unresolved or incomplete start inputs are explained in the Console before skipping; valid inputs send directly. Variable lookup respects scope precedence, including an empty optional Token. / 预设和自定义分开，三个预设相关变量各司其职；有效请求直接发送，参数问题会在 Console 提示后跳过。空 Token 按作用域覆盖集合值。

Exact factory assertions use verify_factory_defaults=true only for response checking; this option never gates sending. / verify_factory_defaults 仅控制精确工厂值响应断言，不影响请求发送。

request.description: Volatile registration/TMSI observation, not an admitted or online-device list. number_source is optional and nullable: subscriber_registry is authoritative for both bindings and unbindings, openbts_tmsi is the native fallback, and inconsistent_registry forces number=null rather than guessing. The top-level source remains openbts_tmsi_sgsn. auth and reject_code are additive nullable integers and may be absent during a rolling 2.1 upgrade. AUTH is a native recorded value, not a real-time online indicator; auth=0 means authentication has not succeeded. reject_code=4 alone has multiple possible causes and does not prove a Ki mismatch. ip=null means no handset GPRS/PDP address was observed and does not prove NAT failure; SMS uses signalling and does not depend on this IP. / 易失注册/TMSI 观察，不是已入网或在线名单。number_source 可选且可空：subscriber_registry 对绑定和解绑均为权威来源，openbts_tmsi 为原生回退，inconsistent_registry 会将 number 置空而不猜测冲突值。顶层 source 仍为 openbts_tmsi_sgsn。滚动升级期间 auth、reject_code 可缺省；存在时为可空整数。AUTH 是原生记录值而非实时在线指标，0 表示鉴权未成功；仅凭拒绝码 4 不能断定 Ki 错误。ip=null 仅表示未观察到手机 GPRS/PDP 地址，不证明 NAT 失败，短信也不依赖该 IP。

request.description:
Only current_start observations are exposed; no all-history switch. Stop/degraded keeps the latest round until the next accepted start; failure of an accepted start attempt clears it. Validation rejection and duplicate-start 409 preserve the existing boundary. No known session (including manager recreation) returns HTTP 200 with empty sms/count/total and session=null, never old logs. One rename rotation to .1 is supported. A lost or unverifiable boundary (for example after multiple rotations) returns HTTP 200 empty with boundary_lost; real I/O errors return 500. Logs are not deleted. timezone is the startup-configured IANA TZ, default Asia/Shanghai; message time is nullable RFC3339Nano with an offset (UTC may use Z). session contains id/started_at/ended_at/state; timestamps have RFC3339 offsets and ended_at is nullable. window retains exactly bytes/max_bytes/truncated, bounded within this round. running only means the observation window is not frozen, not cell readiness; query GET /api/v1/cell. Scope selects this log observation window, not original message creation time; persistent-queue messages reprocessed or replayed during this round can still appear. / 仅返回本轮 current_start；停止或降级保留至下次已接受的启动尝试，已接受尝试失败才清空；参数拒绝或重复启动 409 保留边界。管理进程重建后不读取旧历史，无会话返回 200 空数组及 session=null；支持一次 rename 轮转至 .1；边界丢失或多次轮转后不可验证才返回 200 空数组和 boundary_lost，真实读取错误返回 500，不删除原日志。TZ 在项目启动前配置，默认东八区 Asia/Shanghai；时间带时区偏移，分页和字节上限仅作用于本轮。running 仅表示窗口未冻结，不保证小区 ready，就绪状态查询 GET /api/v1/cell。范围是本次日志观察窗口，并非按短信最初创建时刻筛选；持久队列在本次重新处理或重放的短信仍可能出现。

Preferentially parses keyed GSM_SMS_V1 NOTICE observations whose qtag_hex/from_hex/to_hex/text_hex fields preserve exact content and prevent log-line injection, then merges matching legacy NOTICE evidence by qtag within one smqueue process generation. Older Got SMS rqst qtag events retain evidenced time and parties, but unkeyed text remains null and is never associated; explicitly keyed text and complete local detailed logs remain supported. Records are deduplicated by message identity/qtag, never by content. Missing identity complements are filled only from a unique, consistent current subscriber binding; identity_resolution marks each identity field as log_observation, current_subscriber_binding, or unknown. Log values are never overwritten, 101/411 service codes remain without IMSI, current bindings are query-time context and not historical facts, and rows are not delivery receipts. / 优先解析 GSM_SMS_V1 结构化 NOTICE；qtag/收发方/正文使用 hex 字段，再按同一进程代际内的 qtag 合并旧 NOTICE。旧 GotSMS 仅保留有证据的时间与收发方；不带身份的正文保持 null 且不关联。按消息身份/qtag 去重。身份缺项仅由唯一且一致的当前签约绑定补全；identity_resolution 逐字段标注 log_observation、current_subscriber_binding 或 unknown。日志值绝不覆盖，101/411 服务短码不补 IMSI，当前绑定只是查询时上下文，不是历史事实，记录也不是送达回执。 Native receive supports BMP UCS-2 DCS 0x08 / 0x18..0x1b as UTF-8, skips bounded UDH, and preserves raw TPDU data. Segments are not reassembled; malformed payloads, unsupported DCS and surrogate code units stay unknown (null). POST /sms remains safe ASCII only. / 原生接收支持 BMP UCS-2 中文并保留原始 TPDU；片段不重组，畸形数据、未知 DCS 和代理码元保持 null，发送 API 仍限安全 ASCII。

if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.test('SMS snapshot keeps nullable observations, identity provenance, and pagination metadata', function () { const d=pm.response.json().data; const isOffsetTime=v => typeof v==='string' && /(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})$/.test(v) && !Number.isNaN(Date.parse(v)); pm.expect(d.scope).to.eql('current_start'); pm.expect(d.timezone).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(() => new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en', {timeZone:d.timezone})).not.to.throw(); pm.expect(d).to.have.property('session'); if (d.session === null) { pm.expect(d.sms).to.eql([]); pm.expect(d.count).to.eql(0); pm.expect(d.total).to.eql(0); } else { const session=d.session; pm.expect(Object.keys(session).sort()).to.eql(['ended_at','id','started_at','state']); pm.expect(session.id).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(isOffsetTime(session.started_at)).to.eql(true); pm.expect(session.ended_at === null || isOffsetTime(session.ended_at)).to.eql(true); pm.expect(['starting','running','stopped','boundary_lost']).to.include(session.state); if (session.state === 'boundary_lost') { pm.expect(d.sms).to.eql([]); pm.expect(d.total).to.eql(0); } } const observations=['time','text','sender_number','sender_imsi','receiver_number','receiver_imsi']; const identity=['sender_number','sender_imsi','receiver_number','receiver_imsi']; const keys=observations.concat(['identity_resolution']); const sources=['log_observation','current_subscriber_binding','unknown']; pm.expect(d.sms).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(d.count).to.eql(d.sms.length); pm.expect(d.total).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(d.count).to.be.at.most(d.total); pm.expect(d.limit).to.eql(100); pm.expect(d.offset).to.eql(0); pm.expect(d.source).to.eql('smqueue.log'); pm.expect(d.window).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(Object.keys(d.window).sort()).to.eql(['bytes','max_bytes','truncated']); pm.expect(d.window.bytes).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(d.window.max_bytes).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(d.window.truncated).to.be.a('boolean'); pm.expect(d.truncated).to.eql(d.window.truncated); d.sms.forEach(function (m) { pm.expect(m.time === null || isOffsetTime(m.time)).to.eql(true); pm.expect(Object.keys(m).sort()).to.eql(keys.slice().sort()); observations.forEach(function (k) { pm.expect(m[k] === null || typeof m[k] === 'string').to.eql(true); }); pm.expect(Object.keys(m.identity_resolution).sort()).to.eql(identity.slice().sort()); identity.forEach(function (k) { pm.expect(sources).to.include(m.identity_resolution[k]); if (m[k] === null) pm.expect(m.identity_resolution[k]).to.eql('unknown'); }); }); });

Each explicit start ensures the selected-interface GSM NAT rule before native radio launch; setup failure returns 503. / 每次显式启动在原生射频拉起前补齐所选网卡 NAT，失败返回 503。 Click Send to start directly after parameter validation. Sending starts RF; inspect the Postman Console for NOT SENT diagnostics. / 完整填写九项自定义变量，不传 preset_id、不混合或回退至存档。频段和名称均可配置；参数通过校验后点击 Send 直接发送，发送会启动射频，未发送原因见 Console。

item.name: Mutations / 写操作（手动发送）
item.description: Click Send to execute the selected request immediately. Do not Run the entire folder: deletion and other writes are real side effects. / 点击 Send 直接执行所选请求，不要批量运行整个写操作分组。

request.description: Persists data only; does not start or reconfigure the cell. / 仅持久化，不启动或重配小区。
Replaces name, description, and complete params only; body id is not accepted. / 仅替换名称、说明和完整参数。
Deletes stored preset only; never changes a running cell or last profile. / 仅删除预设，不影响运行小区或上次存档。
Idempotent stop; TERM before KILL.

Atomically updates only the eight public GSM.Radio/GSM.Identity keys documented in API.md; other native keys, including Control.LUR.*, return 422. / 仅原子更新 API.md 所列八个 GSM.Radio/GSM.Identity 键；Control.LUR.* 等其他原生键返回 422。

exec: pm.test('authoritative binding consistent', function () { const d=pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.subscriber.number).to.eql(pm.variables.replaceIn('{{number}}')); pm.expect(d.subscriber.binding_consistent).to.eql(true); pm.expect(['updated','not_present','unavailable','failed']).to.include(d.tmsi_projection); });

request.description: Authoritative Asterisk transaction; TMSI projection is best effort.

exec: pm.test('HTTP 202 submitted', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(202); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.message).to.eql('sms submitted'); pm.expect(b.data.status).to.eql('submitted'); pm.expect(b.data.imsi).to.eql(pm.variables.replaceIn('{{imsi}}')); });

request.description: Maximum 159 bytes from safe ASCII/basic GSM intersection. 202 is submitted, not delivered.

exec: pm.test('runtime-only rule', function () { const d=pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.rule_present).to.eql(true); pm.expect(d.persisted).to.eql(false); pm.expect(d.changed).to.be.a('boolean'); pm.expect([true,false,null]).to.include(d.ipv4_forwarding); });
pm.test('HTTP 422 repeated query', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(422); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.code).to.eql(42201); pm.expect(b.data.errors[0].field).to.eql('limit'); });

request.description: Read-only negative case; repeated and unknown list query keys are rejected.

exec: pm.test('HTTP 422 unsupported config key', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(422); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.code).to.eql(42201); pm.expect(b.data.errors[0].field).to.eql('values'); });

request.description: Negative contract: runtime-managed welcome/admission keys are not public PATCH keys. / 负例：运行时管理的欢迎/接入键不属于公开 PATCH 白名单。

exec: pm.test('HTTP 422 validation', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(422); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.code).to.eql(42201); pm.expect(b.data.errors).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; });

item.name: Number binding rejects reserved service number
item.description: Reserved numbers: 101, 411, 111, 112, 911, 2600 (echo), 2602 (tone). Expect HTTP 422 when binding any of them. / 上述服务与语音诊断号码均不可绑定，返回 422。

exec: pm.test('HTTP 422 reserved number', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(422); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.code).to.eql(42201); pm.expect(b.data.errors[0]).to.include({field:'number', reason:'reserved service number'}); });
